summary: Welcome to Physio Weekly for Sabaa, your weekly look at the research and technology shaping rehabilitation. I'm your host, and this week we've got a solid run of trials and reviews, then a few technology developments worth watching. Let's get into it. We start at the shoulder. A network meta-analysis in Lasers in Medical Science pooled nineteen randomized trials and just under a thousand patients to ask whether adding laser therapy to conventional physiotherapy helps in subacromial impingement. On pain, the signal was cautiously positive: both high-intensity and low-level laser reduced pain scores compared with conventional physiotherapy alone, and neither laser beat the other.
